title: Attach an fentry (BTF-typed) program to vfs_read
question: Does this architecture and kernel support fentry attachment, which requires BPF trampolines?
pass_means: BPF trampoline support is present, so fentry/fexit style programs work.
fail_means: fentry attachment failed. BPF trampolines shipped on x86-64 in kernel 5.5 and on arm64 in 6.0, so older arm64 kernels are expected to fail this probe while x86-64 kernels of the same version pass. This is exactly the kind of divergence this project exists to record.
